query_text: what temperature can food be accepted at

messages.content: what temperature can food be accepted at

message.content:
If you mean **what temperature food can be safely accepted/stored at**, the standard cutoff for **cold food** is **40°F (4°C) or below**; **hot food** should be **135°F (57°C) or above** when received or held.[3][4][6]

If you mean **how long food can stay out at room temperature**, perishable food should not be left out for more than **2 hours** in normal conditions, or **1 hour** if the temperature is above **90°F (32°C)**.[1][2][4][6]

For context, many food-safety sources also define the **danger zone** for bacterial growth as roughly **40°F to 140°F**.[1][2]
